policies.B1: Technical safety verification is approved when a device maintains a battery run time of at least 18 hours, a clinical study size of at least 400 subjects per year, a manufacturing defect rate of 0.05 defects per unit per year or lower, and holds ISO 13485 quality certification.
policies.B2: Regulatory compliance recognition is granted to a device that receives technical safety verification.
policies.D1: National healthcare catalog placement is authorized for a device holding regulatory compliance recognition together with a warranty coverage period of at least 2 years.
policies.B3: Expedited market access is granted to a device with a testing volume of at least 1000 units per year.
policies.B4: European market authorization requires a device to hold CE mark certification.
policies.B5: Extended service durability designation applies to a product with an operational lifespan of at least 4 years.

decoy_policies: Commercial retail channel authorization is granted to a supplier maintaining an annual customer satisfaction rating of at least 85 percent.
Global export licensing requires a minimum annual liability protection level of 2000000 dollars.

B1: Apex Monitor meets all technical safety requirements by operating for 24 hours on battery, maintaining a clinical study size of 500 subjects, keeping manufacturing defects at 0.02 per unit, and holding ISO 13485 quality certification.
B2: Apex Monitor satisfies regulatory compliance recognition by obtaining technical safety verification.
D1: Apex Monitor achieves national healthcare catalog placement by securing regulatory compliance recognition and offering a 3-year warranty coverage period.
B3: Lumina Sensor qualifies for expedited market access by achieving a testing volume of 1200 units this year.
B4: BioFlow Pump receives European market authorization by maintaining CE mark certification.
B5: Cardia Patch earns extended service durability designation with an operational lifespan of 5 years.
